sloka: ऋषीन् वन गतान् राम त्रासयामि ततः ततः ।ततः स्थूलशिरा नाम महर्षिः कोपितो मया ॥३-७१-३॥
transliteration: ṛṣīn vana gatān rāma trāsayāmi tataḥ tataḥ ।tataḥ sthūlaśirā nāma maharṣiḥ kopito mayā ॥3-71-3॥

translations.english: With my appearance I invited the wrath of Sthulasira who I assaulted among the many seers, while he was collecting food in the forest.
